newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fujian Sanmu to list A shares in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: Fujian Sanmu to list A shares in Shenzhen.

text.p: Construction firm Fujian Sanmu Group Co Ltd said on Tuesday it has been given approval by the Shenzhen bourse to list 14.79 million A shares and 1.41 million staff shares in Shenzhen on Thursday.
The A shares were issued recently at 5.00 yuan each, while the employee shares were offered in 1992 at 1.50 yuan each, the firm said in a notice published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Jiangsu Securities and Xiamen International Trust & Investment Co were named as Sanmu's listing promoters.
Sanmu, based in Fuzhou, capital of the southeastern province of Fujian, is chiefly involved in infrastructure projects.

The company said it plans to use net proceeds of about 70 million yuan ($8.4 million) from the offer in the construction of a 180-million-yuan road in Fuzhou with a local partner. Sanmu said it would have a 60 percent stake in the project, with the other 40 percent held by the Lijia Industrial (Fujian) Group Co Ltd.

Before the offer of the A shares, Sanmu had total share capital of 50 million shares, including 30.59 million legal person shares, 18 million state shares and 1.41 million employee shares. The employee stocks become A shares after being listed, Sanmu said.
Sanmu said that under Chinese accounting standards, it has forecast net earnings of 23.32 million yuan for 1996, compared to 13.64 million yuan last year and 13.93 million yuan in 1994.
It said it had after-tax profits of 11.29 million yuan in the January-May period of 1996.
